provenance: MINERvA:2016ymg -- values, absolute stat/syst/total uncertainties, and stat/flux/other-systematic covariance matrices taken from the LaTeX supplementary-material tables (Tables I-VII) in the arXiv source (anc e-print, supplement.tex); target is the MINERvA CH scintillator tracker with cross section reported per nucleon (paper Eq. 1), tagged CH per site convention. No machine-readable (CSV/ROOT) data release was found in anc/; transcribed from the LaTeX tables directly (not the PDF).
cov_note: Block-diagonal 11x11 covariance (5 T_K bins then 6 E_vis bins, matching distribution/row order above). Each block is the sum of the paper's statistical + flux + other-systematic covariance tables (Tables III-IV / VI-VII of the supplement), rescaled from the tables' quoted units (1e-80 (cm^2/nucleon/GeV)^2 for T_K, 1e-82 for E_vis) into the plain numeric scale of the val/err columns (i.e. sqrt(diag) reproduces the 'Total' column of Tables I and V). Off-diagonal cross-terms between the two observables are not given in the paper and are set to 0.
